name: Character Model
title: Attributes, skills, and derived statistics
summary: 07.1 defines seven attributes, independent skills, and checks; 07.2 defines derived values. The delegated Item Creation count formula uses skill, Perception, and Luck; Strength sets the starting weight capacity. Exact XP curves and unrelated system formulas remain open.
scenarioNote: No full player/NPC development scenario was audited.

points.text: No global character level; attributes and skills progress independently through relevant actions.
Seven attributes and the base success curve are owner-approved; remaining mappings/coefficient values are open.
Strength-based Comfortable Capacity is 20 kg + Strength; the load bands run to a 200% hard carry limit. Exact exertion/other penalties remain open.
Item Creation skill, Perception, and Luck affect modifier-count probability under the formula in 19; fixed base type weights remain unchanged.

gaps: Full skill catalogue, action mappings, growth values, and carrying exertion/other penalties remain open; modifier-count and carrying-capacity formulas are specified.
